label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: De novo or recurrent synovial sarcoma is explicitly included in the locally resectable abdominal-tumor study; metastatic lesions are excluded.
cohort_reconciliation: The detailed description places SS in rare-tumor Cohort 3, an uncontrolled treatment cohort. Generic comparator arms do not prove a matched SS control group. Enrollment, masking and randomization wording are inconsistent across modules.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No additional molecular gate is stated. Histologic assessment, resectability and implant-size constraints remain necessary.
protocol_uncertainty: Eligibility/metadata say at most 18 but title/description say younger than 18. External protocol is unreviewed and live slots are unknown. Prior irinotecan is permitted only without documented progression during treatment; no clinical outcome is established.
quotes: de novo or recurrent synovial sarcoma
Cohort 3: 20 participants with rare abdominal tumors including WT, GCT, eMRT, SS, DSRCT and FL-HCC, open label uncontrolled treatment arm to obtain additional safety and efficacy data.

label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: Synovial sarcoma is explicitly named in conditions and is compatible with the NRSTS disease/risk definitions; it is not among excluded histologies.
cohort_reconciliation: Low-, intermediate- and high-risk pathways depend on grade, size, resection and metastatic state. Some receive surgery/observation, others systemic therapy and/or radiation. CIC-DUX4 forces high-risk assignment for that diagnosis, not for SS, and is not a required fusion for inclusion.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No additional SS molecular gate is stated. Exploratory HRD/genomic studies do not require a positive biomarker result.
protocol_uncertainty: Age 1–30 is assessed at diagnostic biopsy. No prior NRSTS systemic therapy, anthracycline/ifosfamide or relevant TKI/radiation is permitted. External protocol and live risk-stratum availability are unverified. Risk cutoffs and arm/intervention mapping details must not be replaced by a single universal regimen.
quotes: Patients must be 1-30 years at the time of the biopsy that established the diagnosis of NRSTS.
Patients must have had no prior systemic therapy for the treatment of the NRSTS

label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: Synovial sarcomas are explicitly named in conditions and compatible with the STS eligibility, whose rhabdomyosarcoma/Ewing exclusions do not exclude SS.
cohort_reconciliation: Single preoperative radiotherapy pathway with individualized proton versus photon selection, not random treatment allocation. Localized head/neck/extremity/girdle/trunk-wall disease and no locoregional/distant metastasis are required, with an uncertain-small-lung-nodule exception.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No molecular entry gate is stated; biomarker investigations are exploratory.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol and live treatment availability are unverified. Age at least 18, travel/procedure capability, prior-radiation and clinical requirements remain applicable. No radiation superiority or safety is inferred.
quotes: Histological diagnosis of STS, except rhabdomyosarcoma and Ewing sarcoma. Pleomorphic rhabdomyosarcomas are eligible.

label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: Synovial sarcoma is explicitly listed for all groups. The study concerns ovarian tissue assessment/cryopreservation/reimplantation in cancer survivors, not antitumor treatment.
cohort_reconciliation: Group 1 requests collection, Group 2 has banked tissue, Group 3 requests reimplantation with early menopause/menstrual irregularities. The malignant-ovary/sample exclusion applies to Groups 1/3, while Group 2 states no exclusions. Tissue-bank/site and oncologist-clearance requirements remain.
extra_biomarker_requirement: Primary-tumor markers are identified for testing banked tissue; this is not a positive tumor biomarker gate admitting SS to a therapeutic cancer trial.
protocol_uncertainty: Eligibility says over 18, and Group 1 under 38 at cryopreservation; metadata 18–38 does not resolve boundaries or other groups' upper limits. External PA105 and live availability are unverified; no transplant safety or fertility benefit is established.
quotes: Patients with Ewing (ES) and synovial (SS) sarcoma
